items.content: E \hat{\sigma}^2 = E \bar{X}_n^{(2)} - E (\bar{X}_n^{(1)})^2 = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{j=1}^n \underset{E X_1^2}{\underset{||}{E X_j^2}} - \frac{1}{n^2} E \left( \sum_{j=1}^n X_j \right)^2
= E X_1^2 - \frac{1}{n^2} E \left( \sum_{j=1}^n X_j^2 + \sum_{i \neq j} X_i X_j \right)
= E X_1^2 - \frac{1}{n^2} \sum_{j=1}^n \underset{E X_1^2}{\underset{||}{E X_j^2}} - \frac{1}{n^2} E \sum_{i \neq j} X_i X_j

= \left(1 - \frac{1}{n}\right) E X_1^2 - \frac{1}{n^2} \sum_{i \neq j} \underset{\mu}{\underset{||}{E X_i}} \underset{\mu}{\underset{||}{E X_j}} = \left( \frac{n-1}{n} \right) E X_1^2 - \frac{n(n-1)}{n^2} \mu^2
